title: Instruction order is conditional on control flow
proposition: Within the selected abstract machine, instructions execute in sequence unless an explicit control transfer, trap, or exception changes the next instruction.
scope: WebAssembly abstract semantics used as a precise teaching model.
exceptions: This does not describe microarchitectural out-of-order execution.
score_rationale: The normative specification is the authoritative source for its abstract machine; the claim is deliberately scoped to that model.
